```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
#Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
# Cleaning data and adding columns for advance time and cancellation in words
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
df <- read_csv("Downloads/nc_hotel_group.csv")
df <- df[df$num_adults != 0 | df$num_children != 0, ]
df <- df[df$weekend_stays != 0 | df$week_stays != 0, ]
df$cancellation_status <- factor(
    df$canceled,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("Not Canceled", "Canceled")
)
df <- df %>%
    mutate(
        advance_bucket = cut(
            advance_time,
            breaks = c(-Inf, 7, 30, 90, 180, 365, Inf),
            labels = c(
                "0–7 days",
                "8–30 days",
                "31–90 days",
                "91–180 days",
                "181–365 days",
                "365+ days"
            )
        )
    )

# bar graph of proportion of cancellations based on channel
ggplot(df, aes(x = booking_channel, fill = cancellation_status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ property) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    y = "Cancellation Proportion",
    x = "Booking Channel",
    title = "Proportion of Cancellation vs Booking Channel",
    fill = "Booking Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
  
# cleaned scatter plot of cancellation rate vs advance time
Q1 <- quantile(df$advance_time, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
 Q3 <- quantile(df$advance_time, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
 IQR_value <- Q3 - Q1
 
df_filtered <- df %>%
     filter(
         advance_time >= Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value,
         advance_time <= Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value
     )
 cancel_rate_by_advance <- df_filtered %>%
     group_by(advance_time) %>%
     summarise(
         cancel_rate = mean(canceled, na.rm = TRUE)
     )
 
ggplot(cancel_rate_by_advance, 
        aes(x = advance_time, y = cancel_rate)) +
     geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
     geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
     scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
     labs(
         title = "Cancellation Rate vs. Advance Time",
         x = "Advance Time (days)",
         y = "Cancellation Rate"
     )


# bar graph of volume of cancellations based on channels
ggplot(df,
       aes(x = booking_channel, fill = cancellation_status)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ property) +
  labs(
    title = "Booking Volume and Cancellations by Booking Channel",
    x = "Booking Channel",
    y = "Number of Bookings",
    fill = "Booking Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
# cancellation proportion based on advance time

ggplot(df, aes(x = advance_bucket, fill = cancellation_status)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    facet_wrap(~ property) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(
        y = "Cancellation Proportion",
        x = "Advance Time",
        title = "Cancellation Proportion based on Advance Time",
        fill = "Booking Status"
    )
  #create canellation rate
 cancel_rate_by_date <- df %>%
     mutate(
         arrival_date = as.Date(
             paste("2000", arrival_month, arrival_day_of_month),
             format = "%Y %B %d"
         )
     ) %>%
     group_by(property, arrival_date) %>%
     summarise(
         cancel_rate = mean(canceled, na.rm = TRUE),
         .groups = "drop"
     )

#cancellation rate by arrival date
ggplot(cancel_rate_by_date,
        aes(x = arrival_date, y = cancel_rate, fill = property)) +
     geom_col() +
     facet_wrap(~ property) +
     scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
     scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d") +
     labs(
         title = "Cancellation Rate by Arrival Date",
         x = "Arrival Date",
         y = "Cancellation Rate"
     ) +
     theme_minimal()

# total lost revenue
revenue_lost_by_property <- df %>%
  filter(canceled == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    lost_revenue = (weekend_stays + week_stays) * average_daily_rate
  ) %>%
  group_by(property) %>%
  summarise(
    total_revenue_lost = sum(lost_revenue, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# total revenue and total potential

revenue_summary <- df %>%
     mutate(
         revenue = (weekend_stays + week_stays) * average_daily_rate
     ) %>%
     group_by(property) %>%
     summarise(
         total_revenue_earned = sum(revenue[canceled == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
         total_potential_revenue = sum(revenue, na.rm = TRUE),
         .groups = "drop"
     )
 

# Calculating cancellation_rate
cancellation_rate <- df %>%
     group_by(property) %>%
     summarise(
         total_bookings = n(),
         canceled_bookings = sum(canceled, na.rm = TRUE),
         cancellation_rate = mean(canceled, na.rm = TRUE),
         .groups = "drop"
     )

# average daily rate at each property
average_canceled_rate <- df %>%
  filter(canceled == 1) %>%
  group_by(property) %>%
  summarise(
    average_daily_rate = scales::dollar(
      mean(average_daily_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#Revenue gained from deposits of people that cancelled - assuming that 10% won't even book
potential_deposit_revenue <- df %>%
  filter(
    canceled == 1,
    advance_time >= 200 |
      booking_channel %in% c("Online TA", "Groups", "Offline TA/TO")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    booking_type = "Require Deposit",
    revenue = (weekend_stays + week_stays) * average_daily_rate,
    deposit_revenue = 0.50 * 0.90 * revenue
  ) %>%
  group_by(property, booking_type) %>%
  summarise(
    potential_deposit_revenue = sum(deposit_revenue, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    potential_deposit_revenue = scales::dollar(potential_deposit_revenue)
  )


#Cancellation rate for required group
current_cancellation_rate <- df %>%
  filter(
    advance_time >= 200 |
      booking_channel %in% c("Online TA", "Groups", "Offline TA/TO")
  ) %>%
  group_by(property) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    canceled_bookings = sum(canceled == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    cancellation_rate = mean(canceled, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cancellation_rate = scales::percent(cancellation_rate)
  )
```
